mines.mine_notes: PEA (preliminary): post-tax NPV5% C$3,367M and IRR 25.0% at US$2,150/oz Au; payback 2.7 yrs from production; initial capital C$1.7B (incl. C$246M contingency); LOM AISC US$844/oz (first-5-yr AISC US$569/oz); avg production 544 koz/yr first 5 full years, 341 koz/yr over 20-yr LOM; strip ratio 1.09:1; open-pit inventory ~7.36 Moz at 1.34 g/t (93% of MRE conversion). PFS commenced late 2025. No mineral reserves declared.
mines.processing: Conventional open pit mining and milling, nameplate 25,000 tpd; ~92.2% gold recovery; year-round road access assumed (North Canol Road upgrades + 130 km new road)

notes: Exploration/development stage company; no production and no mineral reserves. Flagship is the 100%-owned Rogue Project (Valley gold deposit), Yukon Territory. PEA (SRK, technical report filed Aug 27, 2025, effective Mar 1, 2025) envisions 20-yr open pit mine, 25,000 tpd mill, 6.8 Moz LOM payable gold. PFS commenced in late 2025. MD&A prepared as of March 25, 2026; functional currency CAD; no revenue.
report_title: Management Discussion and Analysis for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024

reserves_resources.notes: MRE announced May 15, 2025. 0.30 g/t Au cut-off within ~522 Mt pit shell. Resources not reserves.
